rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single still image, but it speculates about minimal hatching and gives somewhat uncertain ICM/TE descriptions rather than a precise image-grounded assessment.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male-factor context, prior IVF/live birth history, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, with a coherent link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; only minor softness comes from broad probability framing and some speculative morphology comments.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including reliance on lab grading, SET preference, caution about add-ons, and nuanced PGT-A discussion; minor deviations include somewhat broad implantation estimates and speculative ancillary testing.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support review, uterine cavity assessment, activity guidance, and future evaluation if unsuccessful.
